run_e2e_nlg_dataset: run the E2E_NLG dataset module to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_e2e_nlg_instance: create an E2E_NLG dataset instance that wraps the e2e_nlg_cleaned HuggingFace dataset
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of meaning representation and human reference tuples
load_e2e_nlg_dataset: load the e2e_nlg_cleaned dataset from HuggingFace using the datasets library
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot train dev and test splits from the E2E_NLG dataset with a given seed
